data.name: 21’ Duffy
data.headline: Ages 18+ • 1-2 Hours • Up to 10 people
data.description: The 21’ Duffy powerboat rental is perfect for a relaxing cruise around the bay for up to 10 passengers. This electric vessel offers a spacious layout with a wrap-around bench and center table.
data.highlights:
- The Duffy is electric!
- Quiet, smooth and comfortable ride
- Great for picnics on the water!
- Fully shaded

meeting_point.address: 1404 Vacation Rd, San Diego, CA 92109 We are on the Dock out in front of Barefoot Bar & Grill.

data.cancellation_notes:
#24 hour cancellation policy.
###All Cancellations or Rescheduling must be completed no less than 24 hours before the start of the reservation. If you need to reschedule or cancel please click on the Change booking or Cancel booking link in this email.
#Please Note
##- Sailing Lessons have a 48 hour cancellation policy.
##- Pontoon Boat Bay Cruise and Speed boat tour have a 72 hour cancellation policy.
data.booking_notes: #We look forward to you joining us!
data.check_in_details:
Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your reservation time.
- Please make sure to open your confirmation email or text and fill out the waiver(s) prior to arrival at the location
- Bring the Credit card and your matching ID
- All Passengers and Drivers must depart and return from the rental location 
 - A Deposit in the form of a $500 hold on the card when you arrive
- An operational/safety checkout
data.pricing:
As low as $118.72 with our weekday early bird special!
Please select a date and time to view rates, rental durations and availability.
data.special_requirements:
- We recommend wearing the provided life jackets regardless of your swimming abilities 
- Passengers under 13 years old must wear a lifejacket at all times
data.restrictions:
- No beaching the boat
- Swimming is not allowed
- All drivers and passengers must depart and return at our rental location
data.disclaimers: Late arrivals could cut into your rental time.
data.faqs:
What are the age and license requirements to operate and rent?
Must be 18+ with a valid driver's license to operate and rent.
Is a boating license required?
No boating license required.
Are pets allowed?
We are pet friendly.
